messages:
June - CSM: Heads up — IonGrid onboarding: very bursty chat (median 20 tokens) + nightly analytics jobs (seq ~180). Renewal in 5 weeks; they asked for cost options.

Aria - ML Eng: Pattern fits a split-by-intent + compact quant pilot. Short interactive -> compact-int4 or int8; nightly analytic batches -> fp16 or dedicated. Need to validate numeric/report fidelity.

Sam - SuccessOps: Recommend conservative pilot: 3% short-path int4 for <=48 tokens, prefix cache for standard confirmations, watchlist of 40 critical prompts. Acceptance: >=15% cost cut OR p95 <= 300ms AND quality loss <=0.8%.

Lee - SRE: Safety: only run canary 08:00-20:00 customer local. Auto-rollback if error_rate >0.5% or p95 >650ms for 5m window. Notify customer SRE channel on any rollback.

Aria - ML Eng: Quick dry-run routing snippet to push to Console:

```
route_policy:
  - name: iongrid-short-quant-canary
    match: "request.tokens <= 48 && rand() < 0.03"
    target_model: gpt-compact-int4-v1
    fallback: gpt-compact-int8-v1
    metrics: [p95, error_rate, embedding_similarity]
monitoring:
  sample_size: 500
  lookback: 30m
slo_guards:
  p95_ms: 650
  error_rate_pct: 0.5
```

Aria - ML Eng: I'll run a 500-sample regression on their canonical prompts and post embedding-similarity + numeric checks by tomorrow.

Sam - SuccessOps: I'll prepare an enablement note + rollback steps and schedule a 30m ops sync with IonGrid.

June - CSM: I'll pitch this as a "renewal optimization trial" and confirm their opt-in window. If signals strong, propose ramp to 15% off-peak to collect more signal before renewal.

deploy-bot: dry-run canary workspace created /canaries/2741592653-preview. Logs: /deploys/2741592653/preview

Lee - SRE: Action items: Aria -> regression + perf delta; Sam -> docs + sync; June -> customer coordination. Will update thread after regression. :white_check_mark:
